scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem treats precisely two nonempty nonadjacency classes; it is not asserted for larger multipartite bases. The binary parity representation and previous isomorphism enumeration are credited as known premises. Tests through seven named points corroborate rather than prove the unrestricted theorem. Unindexed equivalent historical derivations remain a possibility; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Sharp sixfold fibers of graded singleton types over two-part semigeneric tournaments
